title: Smeshariki "Thinking OST" music for Create pondering
description: Yep , name is 100% true. This mod allows you to listen to Smeshariki"s "Thinking OST" while pondering.
body:
## THIS MOD IS PURELY VIBECODED!

Btw my first upload to Modrinth :>

I am not a programmer , but Youtube's algorithm gave me vid with full PIN-CODE Ost , so i had idea to make this mod. And here it is - now u can gain additional 100 IQ (i think so , maybe not , figure it out urself) while pondering by listening to this brilliant music.

 All this mod does is play the "Thinking OST" from *Smeshariki* (Kikoriki) when you are "pondering" in Create. The audio track is split into several segments for seamless looping, and there is also a volume slider.

(Actually , Discord link is for standalone Minecraft server , where i am just a mod (ridgen) , but anyway you can find me there for giving feedback about mod)
